name: Hegemony Trooper
desc: Polished armor, perfect discipline, no doubts.

intro: A Hegemony trooper in polished armor advances at a measured pace and orders you to lie down.
hit: A precise burst hits you center mass, with no wasted rounds.
The trooper steps forward and fires again, in exactly the same rhythm.
miss: Rounds pass close enough to feel, in a tight and tidy pattern.
The trooper corrects a fraction, unhurried, and fires again.
crit: A single round finds the gap, as though the trooper had been told where it was.
defeated: The trooper falls without a sound, and the polished armor rings on the deck.
lie_worked: You rattle off a clearance code, a section and a superior's name, with just enough impatience. The trooper checks their slate, finds nothing, and doesn't want to be the one who asks.
